HERO.TITLE: Your assistant answers customers from your knowledge
HERO.DESCRIPTION: Add what customers usually ask about, pick the channels, and the assistant replies right away. It hands the conversation to your team whenever a person is needed.
HERO.NOT_CONFIGURED: The smart assistant isn't available on this platform yet. Contact the platform administrator.
HERO.NEEDS_INBOX: Choose at least one channel in the Channels tab so the assistant has somewhere to reply.
HERO.NEEDS_KNOWLEDGE: Add your first knowledge source so the assistant has something to answer from.

USAGE.LIMIT_REACHED: This month's replies are used up. New conversations go straight to your team until next month.

USAGE_REPORT.TITLE: Usage and cost
USAGE_REPORT.HINT: Every call to the AI model is counted here, with its tokens and its cost at OpenAI's prices for {model}. Usage is counted from the day this report was added.

KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Knowledge base
KNOWLEDGE.HINT: The assistant answers only from these sources. Keep prices, shipping, returns and working hours up to date.
KNOWLEDGE.EMPTY_HINT: Start with your shipping and returns policy, or a page from your store.

ADD_SOURCE.TITLE: Add a knowledge source
ADD_SOURCE.QUESTION: Question
ADD_SOURCE.ANSWER_PLACEHOLDER: Orders reach Riyadh in 1 to 2 working days and other cities in 3 to 5.
ADD_SOURCE.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Paste the policy, product details or anything customers ask about
ADD_SOURCE.URL_HINT: The assistant reads this one page. Add each important page on its own.
ADD_SOURCE.FILE_HINT: PDF, TXT, Markdown or CSV, up to 10 MB
ADD_SOURCE.ADDED: Source added. The assistant is reading it now.

BEHAVIOR.NAME: Assistant name
BEHAVIOR.NAME_HINT: Customers see this name on the assistant's replies.

friendly.LABEL: Friendly
friendly.DESCRIPTION: Warm and personal, like a helpful shop assistant

BEHAVIOR.INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOLDER: For example: greet customers by name, suggest our bestsellers, never promise same-day delivery.
BEHAVIOR.INSTRUCTIONS_HINT: Extra guidance on how to answer. The assistant still never makes up information.
BEHAVIOR.HANDOFF_HINT: The assistant keeps the conversation until it hands over, and the conversation is then assigned to an agent, or until an agent assigns it to themselves. Opening a conversation to read it doesn't take it from the assistant.
BEHAVIOR.UNSURE: Hand over when the answer isn't in the knowledge base
BEHAVIOR.UNSURE_HINT: When off, the assistant says it doesn't have that information instead.
BEHAVIOR.MAX_REPLIES: Hand over after this many assistant replies in one conversation
BEHAVIOR.HANDOFF_MESSAGE: Message when handing over at that limit
BEHAVIOR.HANDOFF_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Thanks for your patience, a team member will continue with you shortly.

CHANNELS.TITLE: Channels
CHANNELS.HINT: New conversations on these channels go to the assistant first.
CHANNELS.EMPTY: No channels yet. Add one from Settings > Inboxes.

always.LABEL: All the time
always.DESCRIPTION: Every new conversation, day and night

outside_working_hours.LABEL: Outside working hours
outside_working_hours.DESCRIPTION: Only while the channel is closed, based on its working hours. During working hours your team replies.

CHANNELS.WORKING_HOURS_HINT: Working hours are set per channel under Settings > Inboxes > Business hours.

TEST.TITLE: Try the assistant
TEST.HINT: Write as a customer would. This chat is private and uses your saved settings and knowledge.
TEST.PLACEHOLDER: Ask something a customer would ask
TEST.HANDOFF: Would hand over to the team here
TEST.ERROR: Couldn't get a reply. Try again.
